policy.formal_adapter_threshold: Create an adapter or maintained downstream runtime when the patch count exceeds 24, touched upstream files exceed 30, or two consecutive upgrades require conflict resolution in the same high-risk surface.
policy.upgrade_rule: Every Hermes bump must apply the inventory to a clean pinned checkout, run every declared test, record conflicts, and retire patches whose criteria are satisfied.

patches.purpose: Enforce OKF write authorization and reserved/tombstone invariants in native file operations.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire only when all Hermes file mutations support an equivalent external policy hook.

patches.purpose: Reject doubled wiki path segments caused by confused working directories.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream validates canonicalized write paths equivalently.

patches.purpose: Strip mutating tools from failure-report agents.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream failure agents are report-only by contract.

patches.purpose: Supply corrected DeepSeek v4 peak pricing metadata.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire after the pinned upstream pricing table contains verified equivalent entries.

patches.purpose: Close delegated session rows instead of leaking active state.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream always stamps delegated session completion.

patches.purpose: Thread a lane-specific Ollama context limit through agent initialization.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream exposes an equivalent per-job context configuration contract.

patches.purpose: Select the interactive API model independently from gateway defaults.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream supports independent API-server model routing.

patches.purpose: Rotate available web-search backends to distribute rate-limit load.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if provider rotation becomes an upstream policy extension.

patches.purpose: Initialize only MCP servers explicitly enabled for a cron lane.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream makes toolset-scoped MCP initialization mandatory.

patches.purpose: Expose file reads without a parallel native write path.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream ships an equivalent stable read-only toolset.

patches.purpose: Apply status-specific retry and fallback behavior for local inference pools.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream retry policy supports equivalent per-status configuration.

patches.purpose: Clarify MCP resource URI constraints in schemas and errors.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream schemas and errors provide equivalent guidance.

patches.purpose: Expose actual tool-call counts to completion receipt verification.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream emits authoritative per-run tool-call evidence.

patches.purpose: Expose canonical executed write identities to receipt verification.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream emits canonical write receipts after tool execution.

patches.purpose: Cache local server capability detection per normalized endpoint.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream caches positive and negative capability probes.

patches.purpose: Avoid unsupported metadata endpoints based on detected server type.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream probes only server-supported endpoint shapes.

patches.purpose: Route Qwen Coder custom providers through the Responses transport.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream custom-provider routing negotiates Responses semantics equivalently.

patches.purpose: Honor a bounded per-job maximum agent iteration count.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream supports and enforces per-job iteration ceilings.

patches.purpose: Require explicit terminal receipts for selected-item jobs.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if receipt guidance moves into a stable upstream extension hook.

patches.purpose: Distinguish runtime evidence text from operator prompt overrides.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream scans prompt directives with equivalent provenance context.

patches.purpose: Attach deployment and conversation attribution to Responses traffic.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream provides configurable equivalent attribution headers.

patches.purpose: Fail cron runs whose required MCP surface resolves to zero tools.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire if upstream validates required tool surfaces before agent construction.

patches.purpose: Recover MCP tools lost during reconnect publication races and make unrecovered loss fatal to cron integrity.
patches.retirement_criteria: Retire when upstream atomically preserves or republishes advertised MCP tools across transport reconnects and scheduled runs fail on unrecovered registry loss.
